author: CBR
description:
Sean O’Connell and Sierra Nutkevitch debate which Robin is coming to DC’s Absolute Batman, and why this universe’s mythos flip changes everything.

They dig into the possibility of a Jason Todd-style Robin tied to the Joker, why Dick Grayson feels less likely if Robin is already established, and how the Red Hood gang led by Harley Quinn reframes the whole “Batman and Robin” dynamic.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 19.
